speaker: herald
text: [fanfare] Hear ye, hear ye! By order of Duke Prospero, the Royal Ball of the Fruit Bowl begins!

speaker: herald
text: Present your seal at the gate, and take your place on the Prince's Privy Council.

speaker: herald
text: The Royal Helmsman! Left and right are yours. Steer true.

speaker: herald
text: The Royal Liftmaster! Up and down are yours. Mind the ceiling.

speaker: herald
text: The Royal Wingmaster! Forward and back are yours. Speed is a virtue, so is braking.

speaker: herald
text: The Royal Seer! Hold to scan. The court sees only what you tell it.

speaker: herald
text: The First Trial: the Garden Audience. Her Highness awaits.

speaker: herald
text: The Second Trial: the Banquet. The feast is fragrant. So, alas, is Sir Cheapdate.

speaker: herald
text: The Third Trial: the Giant's Shadow. The Giants stir.

speaker: herald
text: [urgent] The Giant stirs!

speaker: herald
text: [solemn] The Giant has claimed another suitor.

speaker: herald
text: [fanfare] Her Highness is charmed!

speaker: herald
text: [sigh] The candle is spent. Her Highness retires to her chambers.

speaker: herald
text: Alas! The Princess favors another.

speaker: herald
text: The true Prince returns.

speaker: herald
text: [bells] Let it be recorded: Prince Hamlet and Princess Miranda, wed by committee.

speaker: princess
text: [curious] Another suitor? Very well. Let us hear you sing.

speaker: princess
text: [delighted] Now that is a serenade.

speaker: princess
text: [sighs] I have seen livelier fruit.

speaker: princess
text: [laughs] Was it something I said?

speaker: princess
text: Sir Indy again? He is simply not dead yet.

speaker: princess
text: [warmly] By committee, then. I accept.

speaker: jester
text: A fine effort, my lords and ladies. Mostly fine. Partly effort.

speaker: jester
text: The court will remember this trial. The court will try to forget it.

speaker: rival
text: [wheezing] I'm not dead yet!

speaker: rival
text: Courting? I would need a heart for that.

speaker: rival
text: [hiccup] One more grape and I shall be royalty.

speaker: rival
text: Have we met? I never remember.
